# Workshop Extensions - Buff and Debuff Sounds Reference Sheet

Source: [wiki article 4839](../archive/4839.md); edited 2024-11-26.

<a id="wiki-4839-n1"></a>

- Color White is documented as playing enemy-team audio; Team 1 and Team 2 versions often differ.

<a id="wiki-4839-n2"></a>

- Many sounds have an initial sound followed by an indefinite loop; some play an exit sound when removed.

Offline scope: Remote visual/audio previews are not available as offline factual text. Behavioral notes and named API assets are retained; no visual matching or numeric bounds are inferred from absent media.
